metadata.scope: warm local SDK -> gateway stdio -> real stdio fixture; no model/provider/network calls
metadata.corpus: 5000 generated tools; shared broad description token; two discovery pages
metadata.policy: both conditions use default unrestricted tool permissions and enabled code; no code execution measured
metadata.design: four balanced process pairs; 20 warmup searches/calls, then 100 searches and 100 structured calls per process
metadata.timing: SDK roundtrip; excludes startup, initial index build and teardown
metadata.limitations: synthetic regression diagnostic; observations within a process are correlated; pooled percentiles are not confidence intervals or a general speedup claim
